content: Kaolin and pectin are no longer available in the United States. Products such as Kaopectate®, which previously contained kaolin and pectin, are now formulated with a different active ingredient. For more information about these medications, refer to the bismuth subsalicylate monograph. It is important to carefully read the updated information, as the dosage differs, and the new product should not be administered to children under 12 years of age unless specifically directed by a physician. Kaolin and pectin were used to treat mild to moderate diarrhea. In some cases, this medication was prescribed for other purposes. Consult your doctor or pharmacist for additional information regarding its use. Kaolin and pectin were available in tablet, chewable tablet, and liquid forms for oral administration. Typically, the medication was taken after each loose bowel movement. The prescription label provided specific dosing instructions. It is essential to follow these directions precisely and consult your doctor or pharmacist if you have any questions. Do not take more or less of the medication or use it more frequently than prescribed. If using the liquid form, shake the bottle well before each use to ensure the medicine is evenly mixed. Additionally, drink plenty of fluids to replace those lost due to diarrhea. If diarrhea persists beyond 48 hours or if you develop a fever, contact your doctor. Before taking kaolin and pectin, inform your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to these substances or any other medications. Provide a complete list of all prescription and nonprescription medications you are taking, including vitamins. If you are taking digoxin (Lanoxin) or thyroid medications (e.g., Synthroid), wait at least two hours after taking them before using kaolin and pectin. Notify your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. If you become pregnant while taking this medication, inform your doctor immediately. If you forget to take a dose, kaolin and pectin were typically used as needed. However, if your doctor instructed you to take it regularly, take the missed dose as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Do not take a double dose to compensate for a missed one. Kaolin and pectin may cause side effects. Notify your doctor if you experience severe or persistent constipation. Store this medication in its original container, tightly closed, and out of reach of children. Keep it at room temperature, away from excessive heat and moisture (do not store it in the bathroom). Dispose of any expired or unused medication properly. Consult your pharmacist for guidance on the appropriate disposal method. Do not share your medication with others. If you have questions about refilling your prescription, consult your pharmacist.
